fullExplanation.text: Understanding Malachi: Literary Map and Major Movements

Malachi provides the larger frame for Malachi: Literary Map and Major Movements. An independent Catholic study of Malachi focused on covenant, priesthood, marriage, sacrifice, messenger, and day of the Lord. Catholic method here moves from the inspired text to doctrinal judgment while also examining reception and reasoned scholarship.
